title: In the Time of the Butterflies
overview: Based on the book by Julia Alvarez. Three sisters become activists during the Dominican Republic's Trujillo regime when members of their family are killed by the government's troops.

file.itemTitle: "In the time of the butterflies" (2001) Dir. Mariano Barroso; guión de Judy Klass, basada en la novela de Julia Álvarez
